mutations.name: G1 the feed goes back to being chained behind the bootstrap, so it is guaranteed to RUN but not to run SOON and the pill reads disconnected for the whole load window on a slow link
mutations.expectRed: 1.1 THE FEED IS OPEN while the bootstrap read is still in flight, so the pill is not stuck at disconnected

mutations.name: G2 the feed is never opened at all, the older shape where a refused read left the page permanently disconnected
mutations.expectRed: 1.4 control: the feed was opened exactly once, not re-opened per read

mutations.name: G3 the roster bootstrap stops deferring to the live feed, so an older /api/roster snapshot is applied after a live roster event and reverts the agent the feed just announced
mutations.find: { name: "peers", read: () => api.roster(), apply: supersededByFeed("peers", (roster: RosterEntry[]) => store.set({ roster })) },
mutations.replace: { name: "peers", read: () => api.roster(), apply: (roster: RosterEntry[]) => store.set({ roster }) },
mutations.expectRed: 3.1 THE AGENT THE FEED ANNOUNCED IS STILL ON THE ROSTER after every bootstrap read has applied

mutations.name: G4 the membership bootstrap stops deferring to the live feed, so an older /api/membership snapshot replaces the membership the live feed had just established
mutations.find: apply: supersededByFeed("membership", (m: MembershipSnapshot) => store.set({ membership: { snapshot: m } })) }]),
mutations.replace: apply: (m: MembershipSnapshot) => store.set({ membership: { snapshot: m } }) }]),
mutations.expectRed: 3.3 the membership PILL still reports the live feed, not the older bootstrap's stale snapshot

mutations.name: G6 a live membership REFUSAL stops marking its source live, so the successful bootstrap read issued before it applies on top and the pill drops the refusal it had already reported
mutations.expectRed: 5.2 AND THE REFUSAL SURVIVES the older successful bootstrap read landing on top of it

mutations.name: G7 the bootstrap's own membership refusal stops deferring to the live feed, so one read that could not answer overrules a live snapshot that did and the pill calls the whole source unreadable
mutations.expectRed: 5.4 AND THE SNAPSHOT SURVIVES the bootstrap read refusing after it, which is a fact about that one read

mutations.name: G8 the feed's open stops marking the dashboard connected, so the pill stays at connecting after the feed is up
mutations.expectRed: 6.1 a feed open marks the dashboard connected

mutations.name: G9 a feed error stops marking the dashboard disconnected, so a dropped feed still reads connected
mutations.expectRed: 6.3 a feed error marks it disconnected

mutations.name: G10 stop() no longer closes the feed, so a stopped dashboard keeps a live connection
mutations.expectRed: 6.5 stop() closes the feed it opened, once

mutations.name: G11 the live membership refusal is not wired to the controller, so a refusal the server announced never reaches the pill
mutations.expectRed: 5.1 the live REFUSAL reaches the pill at once, so 5.2 has something to survive with

mutations.name: G12 a feed open stops running the bootstrap again, so a reconnect never makes up the events it missed
mutations.expectRed: 6.2 and runs the bootstrap again, because a reconnect may have missed events

mutations.name: G13 the boot calls refresh() without a catch again, so a defect that rejects it is an unhandled rejection that nothing on the page reports
mutations.find: void controller.refresh().catch((err) => console.error("dashboard refresh failed:", err));
mutations.expectRed: 8.2 a refresh that rejects reaches the console
